summary: GNBA.lean compiles with 3 sorry markers, all in completeness counter cycling. Root cause: Decidable instance mismatch between `open Classical in` on gnbaNBA definition and `classical` tactic in proof. Soundness direction fully proven. 688 net lines added.

continuation_context.root_cause: The gnbaNBA definition uses `open Classical in` which provides Classical.dec for the `if B ∈ gnbaAcceptSet` decidability. The `ctr` counter in the completeness proof uses the `classical` tactic which provides Classical.propDecidable. These are different Decidable instances, so `rfl` fails for the transition proof and simp-based extraction of counter conditions also fails.
fix_strategies: Strategy 1: Remove `open Classical in` from gnbaNBA. Instead make the Tr condition a pure Prop (no if-then-else needing Decidable). This changes the soundness proofs too.
Strategy 2: Define ctr inside `open Classical in` block to match gnbaNBA's decidability.
Strategy 3: Add `attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable` before gnbaNBA to align instances.
Strategy 4: Prove hss_trans by case analysis on the conditions and show the counter values match, using hctr_step/hctr_reset helper lemmas already proven in the soundness direction.
